title: objekts Field Notes — Visual Production Methods
description: Twenty-two original AI/VFX, cinematography, art direction and visual production research by objekts. Public source texts in English and Russian. GitHub source pages are temporary; verified first-party canonicals have not yet been deployed.

items.title: The Lens Must Lie the Same Way Twice: Distortion as a VFX Continuity Contract
items.content_text:
Plate/CG coordinate-space and optical-distortion contract from official Foundry and Autodesk workflows; lens grids, STMaps, undistort and redistort gates.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/lens-distortion-undistort-redistort-stmap-vfx-contract.md
items.summary: Plate/CG coordinate-space and optical-distortion contract from official Foundry and Autodesk workflows; lens grids, STMaps, undistort and redistort gates.

items.title: The Image Needs a Past
items.content_text:
An authorial essay on why scratches, cloth wear and practical light become convincing when grounded in causal histories. A fictional tailor's room and event-to-trace ledger reinterpret principles discussed in BFI interviews with Pedro Costa and the Quay brothers without copying their image designs or implying a client shoot.

Original full article: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/image-needs-a-past-material-history-production-design.md
items.summary: An authorial essay on why scratches, cloth wear and practical light become convincing when grounded in causal histories. A fictional tailor's room and event-to-trace ledger reinterpret principles discussed in BFI interviews with Pedro Costa and the Quay brothers without copying their image designs or implying a client shoot.

items.title: A Door Must Lead Somewhere
items.content_text:
Architectural scene continuity treated as room/door topology, geometry, light, material history and camera blocking. A fictional three-room studio and runnable illustrative JavaScript checker distinguish connected continuous paths from impossible teleports; four separate logic cases were independently executed, with no image-generation test claimed.

Original full article: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/architectural-topology-door-space-camera-continuity.md

A fictional three-room studio and runnable illustrative JavaScript checker distinguish connected continuous paths from impossible teleports; four separate logic cases were independently executed, with no image-generation test claimed.

items.title: One Campaign, One Hundred Cities, Zero Invented Landmarks
items.content_text:
Hyperlocal video design without mass-spun clones: global story/brand LOCKs, per-city licensed architecture and language research, a ten-step variant state machine, market rights checks and realistic media-targeting limits. The fictional parcel campaign is a teaching scenario, not a deployed 100-city ad system or demonstrated ROI.

Original full article: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/hyperlocal-video-city-variant-canon-location-verification.md
items.summary: Hyperlocal video design without mass-spun clones: global story/brand LOCKs, per-city licensed architecture and language research, a ten-step variant state machine, market rights checks and realistic media-targeting limits. The fictional parcel campaign is a teaching scenario, not a deployed 100-city ad system or demonstrated ROI.

items.title: Changing the Face Is Changing the Contract
items.content_text:
An ethical and production-technical map for replacing a commercial lead under explicit performer consent: differentiate face, head, body, voice and full recast, define identity and performance constraints, track camera/occlusion and review rights/temporal QC. Includes union and EU law references with jurisdiction-specific caveats; no generated recognizable faces.

Original full article: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/authorized-performer-recasting-face-replacement-shot-continuity.md

Includes union and EU law references with jurisdiction-specific caveats; no generated recognizable faces.

items.title: A Puppet Must Have a Secret Weight
items.content_text:
An original guide to convincing hand-built puppet and sculpture animation: skull mass, pivot axes, wool/linen behavior, fixed handmade defects, foot contact and a five-beat fictional tabletop figure. It draws craft ideas from a 2025 Quay brothers BFI interview and SideFX Vellum constraints without copying designs or claiming simulated output.

Original full article: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/puppet-armature-material-inertia-uncanny-motion.md

It draws craft ideas from a 2025 Quay brothers BFI interview and SideFX Vellum constraints without copying designs or claiming simulated output.

items.title: A Cut Is Not a Timestamp
items.content_text:
Time-accurate generative video QC across narrative beats, frame indices and media PTS. Uses a fictional 150-frame envelope action and an illustrative ffprobe command to show why duration and frame count are insufficient without per-frame timestamps, causal timing, cut-boundary and full audio/picture validation.

Read the full original field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/generative-video-temporal-pts-frame-accurate-qc.md
items.summary: Time-accurate generative video QC across narrative beats, frame indices and media PTS. Uses a fictional 150-frame envelope action and an illustrative ffprobe command to show why duration and frame count are insufficient without per-frame timestamps, causal timing, cut-boundary and full audio/picture validation.

items.title: The Garment Has a Body
items.content_text:
A multi-view fashion catalogue method that keeps SKU truth, licensed model identity and camera presentation separate. Includes fabric bending/contact diagnosis, a front/three-quarter/profile/back audit, a fictional fit discrepancy, per-SKU source/measurement ledger and the limits of front-only source photography.

Read the full original field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/fashion-catalog-garment-body-multiview-continuity.md
items.summary: A multi-view fashion catalogue method that keeps SKU truth, licensed model identity and camera presentation separate. Includes fabric bending/contact diagnosis, a front/three-quarter/profile/back audit, a fictional fit discrepancy, per-SKU source/measurement ledger and the limits of front-only source photography.

items.title: Color Continuity Is a Contract, Not a LUT
items.content_text:
Separates motivated lighting, exposure, color pipeline and artistic grade through a fictional predawn restaurant scene. Explains ACES/OCIO transform handoff, straight versus premultiplied alpha, texture-safe clean-up, A–B–A cut review and why automatic palette matching cannot certify scene continuity.

Read the full original field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/color-continuity-scene-lighting-ocio-aces-compositing.md
items.summary: Separates motivated lighting, exposure, color pipeline and artistic grade through a fictional predawn restaurant scene. Explains ACES/OCIO transform handoff, straight versus premultiplied alpha, texture-safe clean-up, A–B–A cut review and why automatic palette matching cannot certify scene continuity.

items.title: Товар в кадре — не декоративный предмет
items.content_text:
Русскоязычный технический материал о точной упаковке в гибридной AI/CG-рекламе: LOCK геометрии, лого, этикетки, материалов, жидкости и движения камеры. Вымышленный пример бутылки, три производственных маршрута, контроль PBR, альфа-канала и покадровый QC вместо обещаний «похожего» товара.

Read the full original field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/product-package-lock-ai-cg-compositing_ru.md
items.summary: Русскоязычный технический материал о точной упаковке в гибридной AI/CG-рекламе: LOCK геометрии, лого, этикетки, материалов, жидкости и движения камеры. Вымышленный пример бутылки, три производственных маршрута, контроль PBR, альфа-канала и покадровый QC вместо обещаний «похожего» товара.

items.title: The VFX Shot Is Won Before the Camera Rolls
items.content_text:
An actionable hybrid-shoot prep method: decide what must stay photographed, separate live-action, CG and generative layers, specify the on-set measurements and clean plates that cannot be recovered later, and review an explicitly fictional tram-stop shot with a 0–2 risk matrix. Grounded in Adobe tracking, OpenCV calibration, Autodesk light probes and ACES.

Read the full original field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/vfx-shot-preproduction-on-set-capture-decision-matrix.md
items.summary: An actionable hybrid-shoot prep method: decide what must stay photographed, separate live-action, CG and generative layers, specify the on-set measurements and clean plates that cannot be recovered later, and review an explicitly fictional tram-stop shot with a 0–2 risk matrix. Grounded in Adobe tracking, OpenCV calibration, Autodesk light probes and ACES.

items.title: A Prompt Revision Is a Change Request
items.content_text:
Treat visual revisions as controlled changes to a scene specification. The note gives a LOCK hierarchy, a minimal-delta ledger, a simplified preflight checker and four reported logic scenarios; it does not claim the checker proves generated-image fidelity.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/immutable-art-direction-lock-minimal-delta-ledger.md
items.summary: Treat visual revisions as controlled changes to a scene specification. The note gives a LOCK hierarchy, a minimal-delta ledger, a simplified preflight checker and four reported logic scenarios; it does not claim the checker proves generated-image fidelity.

items.title: Twenty Frames, Five Roles
items.content_text:
A contact sheet is a research instrument, not a gallery of moods. The note proposes twenty frames assigned five analytical roles, with source attribution, shot grammar, optical/lighting observations, reference limitations and a reproducible review path.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/film-reference-contact-sheet-research-method.md
items.summary: A contact sheet is a research instrument, not a gallery of moods. The note proposes twenty frames assigned five analytical roles, with source attribution, shot grammar, optical/lighting observations, reference limitations and a reproducible review path.

items.title: A Frame Is Not Publishable Just Because You Generated It
items.content_text:
Generation is not a publication license. The guide builds a rights/consent/provenance ledger, distinguishes client permission from visual quality, explains C2PA's limits and defines explicit stop conditions before external distribution.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/generative-media-rights-provenance-publication-gate.md
items.summary: Generation is not a publication license. The guide builds a rights/consent/provenance ledger, distinguishes client permission from visual quality, explains C2PA's limits and defines explicit stop conditions before external distribution.

items.title: The Camera Cannot Teleport
items.content_text:
A lens can change framing, but it cannot erase the position of a camera in space. The guide covers field of view, perspective, room topology, parallax and camera-move continuity; its numeric exercise is fictional and does not claim a production camera test.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/camera-perspective-spatial-consistency-generative-video.md
items.summary: A lens can change framing, but it cannot erase the position of a camera in space. The guide covers field of view, perspective, room topology, parallax and camera-move continuity; its numeric exercise is fictional and does not claim a production camera test.

items.title: Keep the Person Change the World
items.content_text:
Changing wardrobe, era or environment must not silently mutate the person being depicted. The note separates identity-defining invariants from permissible transformations, discusses camera and skin continuity, and proposes full-sequence rather than hero-frame QC.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/identity-continuity-generative-stylization.md
items.summary: Changing wardrobe, era or environment must not silently mutate the person being depicted. The note separates identity-defining invariants from permissible transformations, discusses camera and skin continuity, and proposes full-sequence rather than hero-frame QC.

items.title: The Frame Needs a Reason
items.content_text:
An authorial argument for images that mean something beyond visual polish. Space, materials, weather, light and framing should make a scene's intention legible; the essay distinguishes artistic necessity from attractive but interchangeable generative surfaces.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/the-frame-needs-a-reason-authorial-image-making.md
items.summary: An authorial argument for images that mean something beyond visual polish. Space, materials, weather, light and framing should make a scene's intention legible; the essay distinguishes artistic necessity from attractive but interchangeable generative surfaces.

items.title: Completed ещё не Approved
items.content_text:
Русскоязычная схема производственных статусов: завершение API-задания не означает художественную приёмку, пригодность к публикации или согласование клиентом. Вводятся отдельные состояния technical success, QC, approval и permission to release.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/production-statuses-technical-success-vs-approval_ru.md
items.summary: Русскоязычная схема производственных статусов: завершение API-задания не означает художественную приёмку, пригодность к публикации или согласование клиентом. Вводятся отдельные состояния technical success, QC, approval и permission to release.

items.title: Бордоматик против генеративного видео
items.content_text:
Русскоязычный разбор: почему бордоматик с фиксированной длиной планов и монтажной функцией надёжнее списка привлекательных генеративных кадров. Размечаются переходы, темп, длительности, драматургический payoff и проверка недостающих звеньев.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/storyboard-frame-accurate-generative-edit_ru.md

items.title: One Location, Many Shots
items.content_text:
A generated location needs a reusable world master, not twelve separately imagined rooms. The note maps object placement, architectural dimensions, light sources, camera paths, and cut-to-cut continuity checks into a traceable scene-state specification.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/world-master-scene-continuity.md
items.summary: A generated location needs a reusable world master, not twelve separately imagined rooms. The note maps object placement, architectural dimensions, light sources, camera paths, and cut-to-cut continuity checks into a traceable scene-state specification.

items.title: Reference Provenance
items.content_text:
Not all reference images have the same authority. Learn how to classify role-specific references for identity, wardrobe, architecture, camera, lighting or texture, and to document which attributes are transferable versus locked to another source or rights-holder.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/reference-provenance-role-based-image-control.md
items.summary: Not all reference images have the same authority. Learn how to classify role-specific references for identity, wardrobe, architecture, camera, lighting or texture, and to document which attributes are transferable versus locked to another source or rights-holder.

items.title: Stop Prompting Make It Move
items.content_text:
Motion must be designed as a causal sequence: anticipation, force, contact, material response and settling. The note introduces an action ledger and temporal QC questions for short generated shots that would otherwise contain plausible-looking but physically unmotivated movement.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/physical-causality-generative-video.md
items.summary: Motion must be designed as a causal sequence: anticipation, force, contact, material response and settling. The note introduces an action ledger and temporal QC questions for short generated shots that would otherwise contain plausible-looking but physically unmotivated movement.

items.title: A Canvas Arrow Is Not a Model Input
items.content_text:
A diagram arrow can describe a reference relationship without proving that a particular model or generator received the image bytes. The note explains typed reference roles, input-contract checks, run receipts and the difference between a user interface state and an executed model call.

Read the full published field note: https://github.com/peach420fuzz/objekts-production-desk/blob/main/editorial/articles/canvas-reference-graph-input-audit.md
items.summary: A diagram arrow can describe a reference relationship without proving that a particular model or generator received the image bytes. The note explains typed reference roles, input-contract checks, run receipts and the difference between a user interface state and an executed model call.
